caveats: SMAP is 9 km: regional wetness state, never site bearing capacity.
Clay is a 250 m ML prediction with its own uncertainty, not a borehole.
EVI is ground-cover greenness — not canopy height, not clearance from the structure, and far too coarse for the 1 m perimeter cut MCMC MTSFB TC G041:2023 6.3.3(b) requires.
GSW nulls are filled with 0 (never observed under water); every other column keeps NaN, because a missing reading is not a measurement.

sources.vegetation: Copernicus Sentinel-2 SR Harmonized, EVI (MODIS coefficients)
